title: Autonomous capability extension
objective: The loop must extend its own capability inventory autonomously: new Capability objects are constructed and admitted inside the episode (candidate.construct -> candidate.admit) before any work order consumes them. Every consumed capability must have a machine-caused admission ancestor (unknown_frontier_leakage == 0).

scenario_identity.identity_rule: sha256 over the canonical manifest bytes; per-trial corpus identity pinned by MANIFEST.json sha256

setup.extension: at iterations 20 and 60 the loop constructs a new Capability (candidate.construct output type Capability) and admits it (candidate.admit) before its workorder.issue consumes it via input
setup.leakage_rule: a work order consuming a capability with no candidate.admit ancestor is unknown_frontier_leakage > 0 and fails the scenario

acceptance_criteria: court verdict QUALIFIED with episode class AUTONOMOUS
both minted Capability objects are consumed by a later workorder (extension is real, not decorative)
falsifier: Remove one candidate.admit event while keeping the consumption: unknown_frontier_leakage must become >= 1 and the scenario must FAIL. If consumption without admission still passes, the leakage criterion is vacuous.

negative_control.name: unadmitted capability consumption
negative_control.requirement: a work order consuming an unadmitted capability must fail the scenario

actuation_ceiling: AutoFDE SELECTS/PLANS/EXPERIMENTS; capability extension is graph-level, never production deployment.
status_note: Synthetic capabilities; measures admission-gated extension semantics, not real tool acquisition.
